svg.aria-label: VoxField. Speech, extraction, saving and lookup each fall back a layer at a time: Cloud STT to Web Speech, Vertex AI to AI Studio to rules, API to an IndexedDB queue, exact asset code to fuzzy match.

g.text: Work orders by voice, for technicians who can't
React PWA · FastAPI · Gemini 2.5 Flash · Cloud STT/TTS
A technician talks; Gemini pulls six work-order fields out of
the speech, scores each one, and asks again when it isn't
sure. Every cloud capability has a fallback, so a dead signal
degrades the app instead of breaking it, and the offline queue
Every cloud capability has a fallback, so the app never fully breaks.
WHEN A LAYER DROPS, THE NEXT ONE RUNS
6 fields extracted, each with its own confidence;
low confidence asks for a re-recording, never a guess
